level.title: Mastery Urdu
goals: Communicate connected ideas accurately for the level.
Adapt register and structure to audience and purpose.
Interpret and produce Urdu with script, romanisation, and cultural awareness.

lessons.title: Precision in specialist health discourse
lessons.learn: Refine implication, rhetorical emphasis, idiom, and audience design. Evaluate near-synonyms and reformulate dense ideas without losing tone or cultural meaning. This lesson applies that control to health & doctor.

grammar.title: Precision in specialist health discourse — discourse control
grammar.explain: Refine implication, rhetorical emphasis, idiom, and audience design. Evaluate near-synonyms and reformulate dense ideas without losing tone or cultural meaning.
grammar.pattern: context + main point + support/qualification + audience-appropriate close
mistakes: Do not translate English clause order mechanically; preserve natural Urdu verb-final structure and match respect, gender, and number to the context.

practice.q: Translate precisely: کمر (kamar)
Write the Urdu term for: leg
Produce this complete Urdu model: I am not feeling well
practice.answer: مجھے اچھا نہیں لگ رہا (Mujhe achha nahi lag raha)
